comparison: 5x steady ceiling versus 20x steady ceiling, fresh six-seed block

flow_substitution.interpretation: Nearly one-for-one substitution from durable governance production into short-cycle political allocation; state-regeneration spending is nearly unchanged.

governance_process: Government-funded locality production that raises administrative, legal, fiscal, social, and expected control.
hypothesis: Absorptive capacity has a temporal/sequence component: exhausting a fungible government capital stock through high-ceiling political spending can crowd out slower governance production even when total expenditure is unchanged.
guard: Synthetic mechanism finding in Pineland internal capital units; not an empirical aid-spending effect size.
